sources.publisher: Office of the Comptroller of the Currency
caveats: Consummated/effective charter status is distinct from verifying that every approved service is currently operational.
Ripple's announcement says RLUSD remains issued by Standard Custody & Trust Company; the national trust bank adds federal supervision and approved trust/custody activities.
Third-party dashboard, not issuer filings.
Use as one provider observation, not an independent confirmation of dashboards that reuse the same source series.
The displayed November 14 row is a Saturday, not a U.S. ETF trading session; treat as anomalous and exclude until issuer-level records explain the date.
Do not silently reinterpret a Saturday row as November 13 or a timezone conversion.

synthesis: Tokenized fund shares on XRPL demonstrate ledger-level distribution infrastructure, but the underlying fund assets remain off-chain and do not represent XRP purchases.
RLUSD settlement on XRPL is a stablecoin payment leg; it may create XRPL activity without using XRP as the bridge asset.
Ripple Treasury's 24/7 Returns announcement is a corporate RLUSD/digital-asset treasury capability; actual balances, yields and realized XRP demand are undisclosed.
C2FO Instant Pay remains an announced initiative with a waitlist; no production settlement volume is verified.
The XRPL Lending Protocol is documented as uncollateralized credit with off-chain underwriting, not automated XRP-collateralized borrowing or liquidation.
DBS/Kinexys is a live permissioned tokenized-deposit corridor and a competing/adjacent institutional rail, not XRP ecosystem usage.
